title: Responses interop fidelity reconciliation and contract adjustments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a reconciled compatibility layer that maps OpenAI Responses semantics to Redwood's runtime and clearly documents lossy transformations, behavioral deltas, and safe fallback policies. Scope: 1) Inventory semantics differences for streaming events, function/tool call lifecycle, and structured output encoding. 2) Propose an adapter contract with explicit transformation rules and error semantics. 3) Define test harnesses and SLOs for parity-sensitive customers. Out of scope: replacing model-side behavior; we only control the translation/adaptation layer. Acceptance criteria: - Comprehensive gap catalog covering at least 95% of observed delta patterns from customer telemetry and internal test corpus. - Adapter contract document (API spec + example payloads) reviewed by Runtime, SDK, and PM teams. - End-to-end test suite with synthetic scenarios for streaming+tool-calling and structured output run in CI with pass/fail thresholds. - Migration guidance doc for customers highlighting behavioral changes and recommended call patterns.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after spike; attached sample traces from customer B and internal fuzzing harness. Observed cases where OpenAI Responses emits 'tool_response' events mid-stream that Redwood currently buffers until completion, causing 120-300ms tail latency in callback routing.

2025-02-24 - Luca Morales: Completed first-pass gap catalog. Key deltas: event ordering (partial vs final), 'reason' fields in cancellations, embedded tool_call metadata nesting differences, and implicit JSONL structured output streaming conventions that conflict with our current chunking algorithm.
2025-02-26 - Design review (Maya Singh): Proposed UX for console tracing to surface adapter-level transformations; asked for payload diff view and toggles to show 'raw' vs 'adapted' messages.

2025-02-28 - Runtime (Kenji Ito): Flagged a runtime constraint: current KV-cache eviction tuned for fixed token chunks — streaming fragmentation from responses-adapter increases cache miss rate by ~7% in bench harness; suggested a sliding-window coalescer in adapter.

2025-03-01 - PM (Evelyn Cho): Prioritized two mitigations for P0 customers: (1) lossless passthrough mode (opt-in) and (2) compatibility mode (best-effort mapping). Need legal review for passthrough retention policies.

2025-03-03 - Luca Morales: Implemented prototype adapter with event transform table and added unit tests for function call lifecycle. Pushed draft PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1984
2025-03-04 - Asha Patel: Noted next steps: finalize adapter contract, add streaming fuzz cases for nested tool_call sequences, and schedule cross-team review on 2025-03-10.
